title: Ensure branch deletions are denied
description: Deleting a protected branch removes both the code and the protections attached to it. Recreating it afterwards restores neither the history nor the restrictions.
remediation: Repository settings -> Branch permissions -> Add restriction: select the default branch and enable "Prevent deletion". Configure it at Project settings -> Branch permissions to cover every repository in the project.
remediationZh: 仓库设置 -> Branch permissions -> Add restriction：选中默认分支，启用「Prevent deletion」。在 项目设置 -> Branch permissions 配置可覆盖整个项目。
